title_hi: FREE UPI का बिल कौन भरता है?

notes: tts = text sent to Sarvam (numbers spelled out in Hindi words, English terms kept in Latin script). display = on-screen/subtitle text. en = English meaning for review. src = fact-sheet row in research/facts.md.

lines.tts: अगस्त दो हज़ार सोलह। NPCI का नया system — UPI — इक्कीस बैंकों के साथ शुरू होता है।
lines.display: अगस्त 2016 — NPCI का नया system, Unified Payments Interface (UPI), 21 बैंकों के साथ आम लोगों के लिए शुरू।
lines.en: August 2016. NPCI's new system, the Unified Payments Interface, opens to the public with 21 banks.
lines.tts_en: August, twenty sixteen. NPCI's new system, UPI, goes live for the public with twenty-one banks.
lines.display_en: August 2016. NPCI's new system, UPI, goes live for the public with 21 banks.

lines.tts: फिर, एक जनवरी दो हज़ार बीस। सरकार UPI और RuPay debit card पर MDR ज़ीरो कर देती है।
lines.display: 1 जनवरी 2020 — UPI और RuPay debit card पर MDR ज़ीरो।
lines.en: Then comes 1 January 2020. The government makes MDR zero on UPI and RuPay debit cards.
lines.tts_en: Then comes the first of January, twenty twenty. The government sets the MDR on UPI and RuPay debit cards to zero.
lines.display_en: Then comes 1 January 2020. The government sets the MDR on UPI and RuPay debit cards to zero.

lines.tts: MDR — वो छोटी सी fee, जो digital payment लेने पर दुकानदार देता है। UPI पर ये पहले zero point three percent तक थी।
lines.display: MDR (Merchant Discount Rate) — digital payment लेने पर दुकानदार की fee। UPI पर पहले 0.30% तक।
lines.en: MDR, the Merchant Discount Rate: the small fee a shop pays to accept a digital payment. On UPI it used to be up to 0.30%.
lines.tts_en: MDR, the merchant discount rate, is the small fee a shop pays to accept a digital payment. On UPI, it used to be up to zero point three percent.
lines.display_en: MDR, the merchant discount rate, is the small fee a shop pays to accept a digital payment. On UPI, it used to be up to 0.30%.

lines.display_en: September 2026: 24 billion transactions in a single month. More than 800 million, every day.

lines.tts: PIB के आँकड़ों के मुताबिक़, सरकार ने बैंकों को incentive दिया — दो हज़ार इक्कीस-बाईस में तेरह सौ नवासी करोड़... और दो हज़ार तेईस-चौबीस तक, छत्तीस सौ इकतीस करोड़ रुपये।
lines.en: Per PIB data, the government paid banks incentives: ₹1,389 crore in 2021-22, rising to ₹3,631 crore by 2023-24.
lines.tts_en: According to PIB, the government paid banks incentives of thirteen hundred and eighty-nine crore rupees in financial year twenty-two... rising to thirty-six hundred and thirty-one crore by financial year twenty-four.
lines.display_en: According to PIB, the government paid banks incentives of ₹1,389 crore in FY22, rising to ₹3,631 crore by FY24.

lines.tts: लेकिन industry कहती रही — ये काफ़ी नहीं। Payments Council of India के मुताबिक़, UPI चलाने का सालाना ख़र्च क़रीब दस हज़ार करोड़ रुपये है... और सरकारी मदद, सिर्फ़ पंद्रह सौ करोड़।
lines.display: Payments Council of India (मार्च 2025): सालाना ख़र्च ~₹10,000 करोड़ · सरकारी मदद ₹1,500 करोड़
lines.en: But the industry kept saying it isn't enough: per the Payments Council of India, running UPI costs about ₹10,000 crore a year, against only ₹1,500 crore of government support.
lines.tts_en: But the industry kept saying it wasn't enough. The Payments Council of India said running UPI costs about ten thousand crore rupees a year... against government support of just fifteen hundred crore.
lines.display_en: But the industry kept saying it wasn't enough. The Payments Council of India said running UPI costs about ₹10,000 crore a year, against government support of just ₹1,500 crore.

lines.tts: और इस पूरे वक़्त, सरकार का जवाब... एक ही था।

lines.display_en: August 2022. The Finance Ministry: “UPI is a digital public good… There is no consideration in Government to levy any charges.”

lines.en: Just six weeks later, RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra said: costs will have to be paid; someone will have to bear the cost.
